idea: Binance positioning / premium / funding / OI as TIME-SERIES signals on BTC and ETH only (earlier tests used cross-sections on today's coins or spikes only); directions fixed by rationale

signals.M1 retail crowding: daily mean count_long_short_ratio (all accounts), z 90 d, 1-day lag; per coin -0.125 x clip(z, -2, 2) / 2
signals.M2 top-trader position crowding: daily mean sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio, z 90 d; per coin -0.125 x clip / 2
signals.M3 premium discount: 7-day mean of the perp premium index, z 90 d; per coin -0.125 x clip / 2 (perp below index -> long)
signals.M4 funding contrarian: 7-day mean funding, z 90 d; per coin -0.125 x clip / 2
signals.M5 leverage build-up: 7-day change of log open-interest value, z 90 d; per coin -0.125 x clip / 2
signals.M6 spot-led demand: log(Binance spot quote volume / perp quote volume), 7-day mean, z 90 d; per coin +0.125 x clip / 2

selection: the Gen380 rule on the pool Gen380 (26) + Gen381 (10) + these 6
